name: ai-news-digest
description: Fetch today's Hacker News front page, let an LLM pick and explain the most interesting stories, and build a digest with real links.

count.description: How many front-page stories to give the LLM

interests.description: What you care about; the LLM ranks stories by this

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the digest (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const data = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const stories = data.hits.map((h, i) => ({ index: i + 1, title: h.title, url: h.url || "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=" + h.objectID, points: h.points, comments: h.num_comments, discussion: "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=" + h.objectID })); console.log(JSON.stringify(stories))'

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --prompt 'You are a tech news editor. The input is a numbered list of Hacker News front-page stories. The reader is interested in: ${interests}. Pick the 3 to 5 stories they would find most worth reading, best first. For each, give its index and one sentence on why it matters. Also write a one-sentence overview of the day. Only use indexes from the input.' --output-schema '{"type":"object","properties":{"overview":{"type":"string"},"picks":{"type":"array","minItems":3,"maxItems":5,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"index":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"why":{"type":"string"}},"required":["index","why"]}}},"required":["overview","picks"]}'

steps.run: node -e 'const stories = JSON.parse(process.env.STORIES); const ai = JSON.parse(process.env.PICKS); const lines = ["📰 Your Hacker News digest — " + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), "", ai.overview, ""]; let n = 0; const used = new Set(); for (const p of ai.picks) { const s = stories.find(x => x.index === p.index); if (!s || used.has(p.index)) continue; used.add(p.index); n += 1; lines.push(n + ". " + s.title + " (" + s.points + " points, " + s.comments + " comments)"); lines.push("   " + p.why); lines.push("   " + s.url); } console.log(lines.join("\n"))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
